title: Notice to Universal Life Insurance Owners: Right to Return the Policy
content:
**Your right to return the policy.** The owner may return a new Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy for a refund of all premiums paid.

**Time limit.** The returned policy must be received no later than the policy delivery date plus the tier's free-look days. The free-look end is found by adding the free-look days in calendar days to the policy delivery date; a policy received on that day is in time. When the sale replaced existing coverage, the replacement free-look days take the place of the free-look days. The delivery date and whether the sale replaced existing coverage are read from the policy record.

**Converted policies.** A policy issued by conversion of an Ashgrove term policy has no free-look right.

## Periods and boundary days (hypothetical; 10 days, or 30 days for a replacement sale)

| Policy delivery date | Replacement sale | Free-look end | Returned policy received | In time? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 May | No | 14 May | 14 May | Yes |
| 4 May | No | 14 May | 15 May | No |
| 4 May | Yes | 3 June | 3 June | Yes |
| 4 May | Yes | 3 June | 4 June | No |

**Example of a converted policy (hypothetical).** An Ashgrove Protection UL issued by converting an Ashgrove term policy and delivered on 4 May has no free-look right, so a return received on 6 May does not give rise to a free-look refund.
